Parameters /// in `decl` that have no corresponding entry in `param_types` are omitted. fn param_types_for_decl( decl: &FnDecl, param_types: &[(String, PhpType)], ) -> Vec<(String, PhpType)> { param_types .iter() .enumerate() .filter_map(|(idx, (_, ty))| { if let Some(name) = decl.params.get(idx) { Some((name.clone(), ty.clone())) } else if idx == decl.params.len() { decl.variadic .as_ref() .map(|name| (name.clone(), ty.clone())) } else { None } }) .collect() }
